rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is generally sad or low in spirits.

example.english: I was glum all day after getting scolded at work.
example.traditional: 今日返工畀人鬧完，我成日都唔開心。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 bei2 jan4 naau6 jyun4 ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the person is visibly sullen, grumpy, or showing a glum expression rather than simply feeling sad.

example.english: You don't have to look glum; everyone was only joking.
example.traditional: 你唔使黑面喎，大家都係講笑啫。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 hak1 min6 wo3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hai6 gong2 siu3 ze1

rows.note: Use this for someone whose face or manner visibly shows sadness and worry.

example.english: After learning that the company was laying people off, he was glum all the time.
example.traditional: 佢得知公司裁員後，成日愁眉苦臉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dak1 zi1 gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 hau6 seng4 jat6 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5
